hooks.command: python -c "import sys,json,re; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); warn=''; exts=('.c','.h'); do_check=any(f.endswith(e) for e in exts); content=open(f,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore').read() if do_check and __import__('os').path.isfile(f) else ''; asil=re.search(r'@asil\s+(C|D)',content,re.IGNORECASE) if content else None; warn=f'WARNING: ASIL {asil.group(1)} file — reviewer approval required before modifying: {f}' if asil else ''; print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PreToolUse','additionalContext':warn}})) if warn else None" 2>/dev/null || true

python -c "import sys,json,subprocess,os; status=subprocess.run(['git','status','--porcelain'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout[:500]; diff_stat=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--stat'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout[:500]; os.makedirs('.codex_tmp',exist_ok=True); open('.codex_tmp/precompact_context.json','w').write(json.dumps({'git_status':status,'git_diff_stat':diff_stat},ensure_ascii=False)); print(json.dumps({'systemMessage':'PreCompact: preserved git status + diff stat to .codex_tmp/precompact_context.json. Changed: '+status[:150]}))" 2>/dev/null || echo '{"systemMessage":"PreCompact: preserve task progress, file paths, error context, test results, MCP patterns"}'

[ "$(git config core.hooksPath 2>/dev/null)" = ".githooks" ] || ([ -f scripts/install_git_hooks.sh ] && bash scripts/install_git_hooks.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"systemMessage":"git hooks activated via scripts/install_git_hooks.sh"}') || true
echo '{"systemMessage":"reminder: settings/hooks 변경 시 .bak 백업 + python -c json.load() parse 검증 의무 (CLAUDE.md L70)"}'
